A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete, readable 22-page paper, including Appendices A–C. Pages 2–22 are pixel-identical, and the first-page article text is identical; visible differences are confined to the marginal arXiv stamp.

before.justification: v4 reports original NSReg evaluations on seven graph datasets, including detection results, ablations, and sensitivity experiments in Section 4 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons in Tables 1 and 3 and the supplementary experiments in Appendix C.

M1.justification: The relation generation, NSR objective, model components, training procedure, and inference procedure in Section 3 and Algorithm 1 are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same open-set detection scenarios on Photo, Computers, CS, Yelp, ogbn-arxiv, ogbn-proteins, and T-Finance. Dataset coverage and task definitions are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the benchmark comparisons, NSR plugin experiments, and regularisation ablations. The corresponding main-text and appendix tables are identical.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix B retain identical preprocessing, anomaly-class rotation, training and test selection, label budgets, model settings, and AUC-ROC/AUC-PR evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: The regulariser and relation-type ablations, normal-anomaly relation experiment, hyperparameter sensitivity analyses, and data-efficiency studies in Section 4 and Appendix C are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions specify five random runs and retain the same averaging procedures and mean-plus-standard-deviation reporting. No statistical or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All reported numerical results and plotted findings are identical. For example, Table 1 retains NSReg's average AUC-ROC of 0.849±0.013 for all anomalies and 0.808±0.021 for unseen anomalies.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, Proposition 1, and its proof and derivations in Appendix A are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about structural-normality regularisation, generalisation to unseen anomalies, and NSR's applicability as a plugin.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged. Section 5 retains the limitation concerning immediate-neighbourhood modelling and the potential computational overhead of extending relation coverage.

D1.justification: The pseudocode, preprocessing instructions, dependency versions, hyperparameters, and visualisation procedure in Appendix B are identical. No code or data access information changes.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, reference list, and positioning relative to prior anomaly-detection and imbalanced-classification methods are unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page marginal stamp changes from v4 dated 2 October 2024 to v5 dated 20 June 2025 and gains an arXiv hyperlink. The article's wording, headings, and structure remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions, equations, and page layout are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. The marginal stamp's textual update does not alter the article layout.

improvement.justification: v5 preserves the same methods, theory, empirical evidence, explanations, limitations, and reproducibility information as v4. The administrative stamp and hyperlink update produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
